posts.author: phony
posts.body:
@jjjtom923
hello, thank you for your kind words!! I'm glad you like it   Also big thanks for testing them out! I tried my best to replicate the original asset formatting on my drawing app, so that's probably why they don't turn out too weird. The ones with arrow, are they the ones that aren't working? I intended them as a rug, not seamless floor. Still, if they don't work as intended, I will probably have to move them onto sheet C
